title: Wii Sports Resort
shortDescription: Wuhu Island vacation resort bundling the Wii MotionPlus accessory across Swordplay, Archery, and Wakeboarding.
historicalSignificance: Sold over 33 million copies, establishing Wuhu Island as one of Nintendo's most beloved environmental spaces.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
